subject: sounds
title: Same last sound
about: Hear a word and tap the word that ends with the same sound, with no letters shown. This is the by-ear partner of the Last sounds level and completes NC RF.1.3.c (isolating the final sound) without any print.
tip: Have him say the cue word and hold the very last sound (sunnn), then try each choice.

cards.q: Which word ends with the same sound as cat?
cards.note: cat and boat both end with the same sound.
